title: Classifier spend is invisible to RUN_MAX_COST_USD: the jev route is vendor-direct, so its cost never reaches the gateway logs the budget acts on
body: The factory's cost ground truth is the operator's AI Gateway logs, and the jev route deliberately bypasses them (no TypeSafe provider to proxy). Classification is ~$0.001 per tick and lands per-call in the decision record's usage field, but the Run Workflow's budget never sums it — a run's cost_usd understates by its classification spend. Either accept and document that ceiling, or have the budget read the recorded classification usage too.
